title: FJAAK | Techno DJ Set | SECTION. | May 2026
description:
SECTION. presents FJAAK from Berlin, Germany.

FJAAK are Felix Wagner and Aaron Robig, a duo who grew up together in Spandau on the western outskirts of Berlin and absorbed the city's techno heritage from the inside out. They began releasing on Baalsaal Music before launching their own FJAAK Records imprint, which has become one of Berlin's most respected hardware-focused labels. Rooted in the tradition of Berlin warehouse culture, their output sits at the intersection of classic techno, house, and breakbeat - always built from machines, always aimed squarely at the floor.

FJAAK's DJ sets carry the unmistakeable energy of a duo who grew up in rooms where the music never stopped. Their selections are physical and propulsive, rooted in heavy kicks and hypnotic percussion but with an ear for the kind of moments that make a crowd lose track of time entirely. There's a rawness to what they do that feels genuinely Berlin - unfussy, direct, and completely committed to the function of the dancefloor.

Berlin-born, hardware-raised - FJAAK deliver the real thing to SECTION.
